items.question: What stream difference will be shown in the ninth chapter?
premises: the ninth chapter will show it
items.inference: the passage announces a forthcoming exposition of scriptural stream difference
items.plain_english: The scripture has indicated a difference of streams, which we will show in the ninth chapter.

items.question: By what means is the speaker asked to speak?
items.inference: the addressee is urged to speak through grace and favor
items.plain_english: Speak by grace, through the manifestation of inner purity, and by favor.

items.question: Why is something not indicated separately?
premises: it is included within another topic
items.inference: the item is omitted separately because it is already included
items.plain_english: Because it is included, it is not indicated separately.

items.question: What is the focus even in the initial statement?
premises: the initial statement focuses on main purpose
items.inference: the passage emphasizes explaining the main purpose from the outset
items.plain_english: Even in the initial statement, the focus is on explaining the main purpose.

items.question: Why is the essence of Śiva nondifference pervasion shown?
premises: it is about to be shown
items.inference: the passage prepares to show the essence of Śiva nondifference pervasion
items.plain_english: Because it is about to be shown, the essence of Śiva nondifference pervasion is presented.

items.question: How is the preceding statement characterized?

items.plain_english: It is as if already said.
